title: MAI audio models cover files, live speech, and voices
summary:
New MAI audio models and typed decisions led a day of API compatibility fixes, community additions, and less surprising developer tools.

Three team PRs added MAI Transcribe 2 for multilingual audio files, a streaming variant for live WebSocket transcription, and two MAI Voice text-to-speech models with 97 voices. Transcription docs also clarify which models support subtitle formats.

A Quest contribution added paid-only `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` for choice, score, and predicate questions that return typed answers with probabilities and confidence. The shared Decisions adapter also stopped cutting off slow requests at its local 30-second deadline, while provider region rejections can now trigger a configured fallback.

Four community apps joined the catalog, and screenshots were added to its 31 remaining entries without previews. A new Service Providers page explains inference and tool data flows and identifies details that remain unverified. Smaller updates corrected catalog languages and Quest standings.

daily.title: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
daily.text: Ask choice, score, or predicate questions with `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` and get typed answers with probabilities and confidence instead of prose. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions).

daily.title: MAI file transcription
daily.text: Transcribe multilingual audio files with `microsoft/mai-transcribe-2`, including automatic language detection and timed segments. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-transcribe-2).

daily.title: MAI live transcription
daily.text: Send live PCM audio to `microsoft/mai-transcribe-2-streaming` over the realtime WebSocket API and receive incremental finalized text. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-transcribe-2-streaming).

daily.title: MAI-Voice-2.1 speech
daily.text: Generate speech with MAI-Voice-2.1, choosing from 97 voices and MP3 or 24 kHz PCM output. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=MAI-Voice-2.1).

daily.title: MAI-Voice-2.1 Flash
daily.text: Generate speech with MAI-Voice-2.1 Flash, with the same 97-voice selection and MP3 or 24 kHz PCM output. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=MAI-Voice-2.1%20Flash).
